n:AYA Bank: AYA Bank is a bank based in Yangon, Myanmar, and it is tied here to one central bank. Khin Saw Oo, formerly Deputy Governor of the Central Bank of Myanmar, went from that post to Vice-Chairman of AYA Bank, joining the bank in 2018, and was re-designated Executive Chairman in May 2021. The bank's own leadership page sets out the appointment and the dates.
n:Banco Agrícola: Banco Agrícola is a bank based in San Salvador, El Salvador. Its tie to the Central Reserve Bank of El Salvador runs through one person. Rafael Barraza Domínguez served as President of the Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador, and earlier as its Vice-President and as its Studies and Economic Policy Manager, and then became Chief Executive Officer of Banco Agrícola.
n:Banco Ficohsa: Banco Ficohsa is a bank based in Tegucigalpa, Honduras. Wilfredo Rafael Cerrato Rodríguez, who became President of the Banco Central de Honduras on 27 January 2018, had earlier worked at Banco FICOHSA as a credit officer and then as an agency manager, from January 1997 to February 2003. That commercial banking spell, years before the central bank appointment, is the connection recorded here.
n:Banco Mercantil (Honduras): Banco Mercantil, S.A. is a bank based in Tegucigalpa, Honduras. Wilfredo Rafael Cerrato Rodríguez, who became President of the Banco Central de Honduras on 27 January 2018, worked at Banco Mercantil as a credit officer from November 1993 to April 1996. That was the first of several commercial banking jobs he held before the central bank appointment, more than twenty years later.
n:Banco Sicredi: Banco Sicredi is a bank based in Porto Alegre, Brazil, and the tie recorded here is to the Central Bank of Aruba. Thomas Domhoff, President of the Centrale Bank van Aruba from 1 July 2026, had held a directorship at Banco Sicredi, alongside project roles at ING, ABN AMRO, Rabobank and Capgemini, before taking up the central bank post.
n:Banco de la Producción (Banpro): Banco de la Producción, or Banpro, is a bank in Managua, Nicaragua. Luis Rivas Anduray was an economic adviser at the Banco Central de Nicaragua from 2001 to 2002, then ran the finance ministry's fiscal affairs office to 2003, and became Banpro's general manager at the end of 2004; he is now its chief executive. A report on the Nueva Tenedora Banpro holding states that Banpro's majority shareholder is Grupo Promerica, the second Central American financial group of private capital, and that Banpro was owned by Ramiro Ortiz Mayorga.
n:Bancolombia: Bancolombia is a bank based in Medellín, Colombia. Its corporate governance page states that Rafael Barraza Domínguez held the presidency, vice-presidency and studies and economic policy management of El Salvador's central bank, and is currently chief executive of Banco Agrícola. A rating report filed with the Salvadoran stock exchange states that Banco Agrícola's ultimate shareholder is Bancolombia, that the bank belongs to the Banagricola conglomerate owned by Bancolombia Panama, and that the three companies sit under the holding company Inversiones Financieras Banco Agricola, S.A.
n:Bank of Sahel and Sahara Community: The Bank of Sahel and Sahara Community is based in Tripoli, Libya, and the tie recorded here is to the Central Bank of Sudan. Mohamed Khair Ahmed Al-Zubair was its Vice President from 2002 to 2009 and became Governor of the Central Bank of Sudan in March 2011. Earlier he had been Sudan's Minister of Finance and National Economy from 2000 to 2001 and president of the board of the Saudi Sudanese Bank.
n:Deloitte (Malawi) with Deloitte & Touc: Deloitte (Malawi) with Deloitte & Touche (South Africa) is one joint appointment, naming the two Deloitte member firms that together hold the external audit of the Reserve Bank of Malawi, Malawi's central bank; the Malawian firm is in Blantyre. The joint auditors audited the central bank's consolidated and separate accounts for the year ended 31 December 2025, and the reports were signed on 30 June 2026.
n:Financial and Administrative Control B: The Financial and Administrative Control Bureau is Palestine's state audit body, which checks how public money is handled. In its 2020 annual report it qualified its audit of the Ministry of Finance's consolidated closing account, meaning it did not give those accounts a clean opinion. One finding was that the ministry had not disclosed an amount of 2,130,918 dinars that it owed to the Palestine Monetary Authority. The finding is against the ministry's disclosure; the Monetary Authority is the creditor.
n:First Bank of Nigeria: First Bank of Nigeria is a bank based in Lagos, Nigeria, and the tie here runs through its Gambian subsidiary. Alassan Jabby, also written Jabbie, joined the Central Bank of The Gambia in late 2004 as the accountant in charge of its treasury unit, and is now Executive Director and Business Development Manager of FirstBank Gambia Limited. FirstBank Gambia's own page states that it is a subsidiary of FirstBank of Nigeria Limited, which is listed on the Nigeria Stock Exchange with over 1.3 million shareholders.
n:FirstBank Gambia Limited: FirstBank Gambia Limited is a bank based in Banjul, Gambia. Its tie to the Central Bank of The Gambia runs through one person. Alassan Jabby, also written Jabbie, was the accountant in charge of the treasury unit at the Central Bank of The Gambia, which he joined in late 2004, and he went on to become Executive Director and Business Development Manager of FirstBank Gambia Limited.
n:Government of Uruguay: Uruguay's executive has standing constitutional powers over the Banco Central del Uruguay, an ente autonomo, or autonomous state body. Article 197 lets it object to and suspend such a body's acts and, if the objections are disregarded, order rectifications, correctives or removals. Article 198 lets it remove board members with the Senate's consent for ineptitude, omission or crime in office, or alone if the Senate does not rule within sixty days; such removals carry no right of appeal. Article 14 of the bank's charter designates its directors under article 187.
n:Grupo Promerica: Grupo Promerica is based in Panama City, Panama. Its tie to the Central Bank of Nicaragua runs through Luis Rivas Anduray, an economic adviser at the Banco Central de Nicaragua from 2001 to 2002, who later ran the finance ministry's fiscal affairs office to 2003 and became general manager of Banpro at the end of 2004, where he is now chief executive. A report on the Nueva Tenedora Banpro holding states that Grupo Promerica is Banpro's majority shareholder and the second Central American financial group of private capital.
n:Intermediaria Financiera, S.A. (Grupo: Intermediaria Financiera, S.A. is a company in Tegucigalpa, Honduras, and part of Grupo FICOHSA. Wilfredo Rafael Cerrato Rodríguez, who became President of the Banco Central de Honduras on 27 January 2018, worked there as a credit officer from September to December 1996. It was one of several commercial banking jobs he held in the 1990s and early 2000s, long before the central bank appointment.
n:Ivory Bank: Ivory Bank is a bank based in Juba, South Sudan. Addis Ababa Othow joined the Central Bank of Sudan as a banking inspector in 1997 and joined Ivory Bank in 1998. He joined the Bank of South Sudan in 2010 as head of its non-banking division, later worked for Equity Bank in Nairobi and in South Sudan, served as First Deputy Governor from 2022 to October 2023 and again from February 2025, and was appointed Governor in June 2025.
n:Kanbawza Bank (KBZ): Kanbawza Bank, known as KBZ, is a bank based in Yangon, Myanmar. Than Lwin was an economist at the Central Bank of Myanmar from 1966, became a Director in 1997, and served as Deputy Governor and Controller of Foreign Exchange from 1997 to 2003. In 2004 he joined Kanbawza Bank as a consultant, and he is listed as its Deputy Chairman. An interview with KBZ's senior managing director calls it Myanmar's largest privately owned financial institution and the largest of the country's 19 privately owned banks.
n:Karafarin Bank: Karafarin Bank is a privately owned bank based in Tehran, Iran. Its tie to the Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran runs through one appointment. Valiollah Seif was managing director of Karafarin Bank before he was appointed Governor of the Central Bank of Iran in August 2013.
n:Ministry of Finance of Palestine: The Ministry of Finance of Palestine appears here through an audit of its own accounts. In its 2020 annual report, Palestine's Financial and Administrative Control Bureau qualified its audit of the ministry's consolidated closing account, meaning it did not give those accounts a clean opinion. One finding was that the ministry had not disclosed an amount of 2,130,918 dinars that it owed to the Palestine Monetary Authority. The finding is against the ministry's disclosure; the Monetary Authority is the creditor.
n:National Pension & Provident Fund of B: The National Pension & Provident Fund of Bhutan, based in Thimphu, is the country's pension and provident fund. Dasho Penjore was Deputy Managing Director of the Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan, the country's central bank, from 2003 to 2006, then served as Chief Chamberlain to the King and as Chief Executive Officer of the National Pension & Provident Fund, and became Governor of the Royal Monetary Authority in December 2015.
n:Palestine Islamic Bank: Palestine Islamic Bank is a bank in Palestine, and its tie to the Palestine Monetary Authority runs through one appointment. Yahya Shunnar was a director at the Palestine Islamic Bank and vice-chairman of Tamkeen Insurance Company, and he took office as Governor of the Palestine Monetary Authority on 4 January 2025.
n:President of Guyana: The President of Guyana holds powers over the Bank of Guyana under the Bank of Guyana Act, Chapter 85:02, Act No. 19 of 1998, enacted 31 December 1998. Section 3(1) describes the Bank as an autonomous institution governed by that Act. Section 14(2) lets the President end the Governor's appointment, and the Minister end any other Director's, on stated grounds. Under section 29 the Minister, in consultation with the Bank, sets the policies, principles and criteria of Guyana's exchange rate system, and the Bank handles only its day-to-day administration.
n:Rawbank: Rawbank is a bank based in Kinshasa, DR Congo. Its tie to the Central Bank of the Congo runs through one person. Leny Ilondo was a Director at the Central Bank of Congo until his retirement, and has sat on Rawbank's board as a non-executive director since 2024, serving on its risk and audit committees.
n:Richard Gibson: Richard Gibson was Curaçao's finance minister. A report of 26 May 2017 said the Supervisory Board of the Central Bank of Curaçao and Sint Maarten had voted three to two to extend a managing director's term, short of the supermajority required, and that Gibson had written to the board members Robert Pietersz, Tom Kok, Miriela Carolina, Vance Williams and Hubert Lopez asking them to work on a solution. He said that without a solution there would be no other choice but dismissal of the board.
n:Saudi Sudanese Bank: The Saudi Sudanese Bank is based in Khartoum, Sudan. Mohamed Khair Ahmed Al-Zubair was president of its board, and was Sudan's Minister of Finance and National Economy from 2000 to 2001 and Vice President of the Bank of Sahel and Sahara Community from 2002 to 2009, before becoming Governor of the Central Bank of Sudan in March 2011.
n:Standard Lesotho Bank Limited: Standard Lesotho Bank Limited is a bank based in Maseru, Lesotho. Mr. O. 'Nete worked at Standard Bank of Lesotho as Senior Finance Manager, Finance Manager and Senior Manager Personal Credit, and earlier as Tax Manager at Stanlib, and now sits as a Non-Executive Director on the board of the Central Bank of Lesotho.
n:Stanlib: Stanlib is a company based in Maseru, Lesotho. Mr. O. 'Nete was its Tax Manager, and later held the posts of Senior Finance Manager, Finance Manager and Senior Manager Personal Credit at Standard Bank of Lesotho, before becoming a Non-Executive Director on the board of the Central Bank of Lesotho.
n:Tamkeen Insurance Company: Tamkeen Insurance Company is an insurance company based in Palestine, and it appears here through one career move. Yahya Shunnar was vice-chairman of Tamkeen Insurance Company and a director at the Palestine Islamic Bank, and he took office as Governor of the Palestine Monetary Authority on 4 January 2025.
n:Trade Bank of Iraq: The Trade Bank of Iraq is a bank based in Baghdad, Iraq, and the tie recorded here is a single career move. Faisal Wisam al-Heims was Director-General of the Trade Bank of Iraq before he was appointed Deputy Governor of the Central Bank of Iraq in March 2023.
